name: meridian-mfe
description: Meridian ERP — micro-frontend monorepo (Vite + Module Federation)

scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/shell run build && npm --prefix apps/core run build && npm --prefix apps/procurement run build && npm --prefix apps/hr run build && npm --prefix apps/finance run build && npm --prefix apps/projects run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shell,core,procurement,hr,finance,projects -c magenta,red,cyan,green,yellow,blue "npm --prefix apps/shell run dev" "npm --prefix apps/core run serve" "npm --prefix apps/procurement run serve" "npm --prefix apps/hr run serve" "npm --prefix apps/finance run serve" "npm --prefix apps/projects run serve"
scripts.preview: concurrently -n shell,core,procurement,hr,finance,projects -c magenta,red,cyan,green,yellow,blue "npm --prefix apps/shell run preview" "npm --prefix apps/core run preview" "npm --prefix apps/procurement run preview" "npm --prefix apps/hr run preview" "npm --prefix apps/finance run preview" "npm --prefix apps/projects run preview"
